mu_name_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp loads the crossbows as MODEL_BOW + i + 8 from CrossBow{i+1}, so number 13 is CrossBow06.bmd; _enum.h names MODEL_BLUEWING_CROSSBOW = MODEL_BOW + 13, and mu.db agrees.
why_this_one: Devias's merchants (Izabel, Zienna in src/sim/market.cpp) list the Bluewing Crossbow, and the shelf dropped the line for want of a cooked mesh.

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser rather than restated, with the call it came from beside it.

stance_from: MuWeapons.cs (the old client's table, LEGACY history 085a8169^:godot/Assets/Items/MuWeapons.cs): WeaponStance.Crossbow, TwoHanded: true. Actions 9 and 22.
fires_note: ZzzEffectMagicSkill.cpp: `case MODEL_BLUEWING_CROSSBOW: CreateEffect(MODEL_ARROW_WING, ...)`. ArrowWing is not built, so `fires` is left out and src/game/fx/arrow.cpp's modelFor sends number 13 to the steel bolt.
sheet_from: Data/Item/jk00.OZJ (128x64) and jk01.OZJ (64x32), from MuMain at c0d74c4. The .bmd names jk00.jpg on 112 triangles and jk01.jpg on 112.
sheet_note: jk00 is dark gunmetal plates with a pale boss. jk01 is black with a few orange strokes - a sheet drawn to be added.
glow_note: MuMain draws this crossbow transparent. ItemObjectAttribute (ZzzObject.cpp:5243-5246): `case MODEL_BLUEWING_CROSSBOW: BlendMesh = -2; BlendMeshLight = sin(WorldTime*0.004)*0.3 + 0.7`, and BMD::RenderMesh (ZzzBMD.cpp:1509, `blendMeshIndex <= -2 || m->Texture == blendMeshIndex`) draws every mesh added when BlendMesh <= -2 - so the whole Bluewing is a breathing additive ghost, and both sheets are glows here. jk01 (black with orange strokes) is a shell coincident with jk00's and clean_lowpoly's weld drops it as duplicate faces, so its glow names no faces and export_gltf says so; jk00's shell carries the look alone.
material_note: No baked material: MU draws both meshes added (see glow_note), so the crossbow ships as glow parts on MU's raw sheets. The islands below are what islands.py measured; their materials go unused.
